name: UI UX Pro Max Skill
hook: 137.5k stars. name: RTK (Rust Token Killer)
hook: 84k stars, updated Oct 19. A CLI proxy that intercepts command output (logs, test results, JSON, CSV) and compresses it before it reaches your agent's context, claiming 60–90% token reduction on common dev commands. Supports Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and 15 other tools. Run 'rtk gain' after install to verify you have the right package.

name: Sonnet 5.5 Cache Reads → $0.10/M (Claude Code v2.1.296)
hook: Official Anthropic change in v2.1.296 (Oct 9): Sonnet 5.5 prompt-cache read tokens repriced from $0.20/M to $0.10/M — a 50% cut. Also adds CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL and CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS for 529 backoff tuning. Effective immediately; no action needed.

name: Graphify
hook: 128.9k stars, updated Oct 16. Turns a codebase — plus docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs — into a queryable knowledge graph using local tree-sitter AST parsing. One search noted 25.4k new stars in the last 30 days.
install: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install

name: Claude Code v2.1.295 — Hooks Can Now Block Actions
hook: Official Anthropic (Oct 8): v2.1.295 adds 'onFailure: block' to command and HTTP hooks — a hook that fails to start, times out, or exits unexpectedly now blocks the action rather than silently continuing. Also adds OSC 7501 terminal protocol so compatible terminals can show Claude Code's live status, and raises the MCP tool description limit to 16,384 characters (up from 2,048).
